data.name: Katriel
data.gender_notes: Katriel is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Hebrew 'Katriel' meaning pure and precious. In the Bible, it is a name given to a saint and a Hebrew boy. Symbolizes purity and being a treasure of God. The name Katriel carries the meaning “Pure, God's treasure” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Katriel usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, god's treasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes being a pure vessel of God's grace and a precious treasure in His sight.
data.etymology: Katriel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, God's treasure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Katriel total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

This is reflected in the meaning of the name, which signifies purity and being a treasure. In the Bible, the name Katriel is given to a saint and a Hebrew boy, emphasizing the connection between the name and spiritual good. The name serves as a reminder of the importance of striving for spiritual purity and cherishing the gift of life, as we are all precious in the eyes of God. The name Katriel is a reminder of the spiritual journey we embark on in life and the importance of remaining pure and precious in our thoughts, words, and deeds.

In Christian tradition, Katriel represents the purity of heart and spirit desired by God.
